method: Within-marker centering; paired multinomial resampling of 89 whole markers, 2000 draws across 24 specifications, and omission of every marker. Expanded-row numerical checks retained.
reference_distribution: Observed site-weighted means held fixed for all resamples and leave-one-out fits; no causal intervention interpretation.
intervals: Unadjusted percentile 95% marker-bootstrap intervals, not new multiplicity-adjusted significance tests. Singular draws retained explicitly.
interpretation: Sensitivity to marker sampling/influence conditional on fixed rates, gene trees and observed covariates. Does not propagate phylogenetic/rate estimation uncertainty or resolve cross-marker dependence, nonlocal alphabet artifacts, prediction circularity or causal exposure effects.
cost: Existing authorized host; no new charges
